g.title: j1519678314
g.text: I really, really don't like where this is going, Flare... what're you talking about?

g.title: j2917642112
g.text: If you're talking about tossing her into the Void... the answer is no.

g.title: j1239390230
g.text: i'm not talking about the void

g.title: j1974921227
g.text: I don't know what kind of presence the Infestation has in the Void, and I'm not about to make it worse.

g.title: j3547712796
g.text: i'm talking about duviri

g.title: j3474015990
g.text: I guess that *would* teach Thrax a lesson...

g.title: j1743065167
g.text: WHAT. NO! Absolutely not!

g.title: j3083007100
g.text: I - how do you know about Duviri?!

g.title: j2136297088
g.text: seems like you owe it no favors after what it did to you

g.title: j1170740964
g.text: i can *talk* to the other protoframes, you know

g.title: j1613943964
g.text: What gives you the right to tell me I should let it go straight to hell?

g.title: j577024962
g.text: Maybe. Maybe not.

g.title: j3428716847
g.text: You're oversimplifying the situation. Duviri was - and *is* - far more than just a "place."

g.title: j258580149
g.text: and they've filled me in all about the weird little wild world you lived in

g.title: j3491081430
g.text: You've never been there. You didn't spend centuries there. You haven't lived and died there.

g.title: j1151062565
g.text: To cut to the chase, Flare? That place is... as much a reflection of me, as it is the storybook it's based on.

g.title: j2072719475
g.text: While my feelings on it aren't exactly... rosy... I can't very well chuck the Infestation into it and walk away.

g.title: j2104199857
g.text: And as much as sometimes I like to go back there and repeatedly punch people in the face... It's not my garbage disposal.

g.title: j3635492351
g.text: Whether I like it or not... I'm somehow, stupidly, the person responsible for that place.

g.title: j2742852379
g.text: I have just as many pleasant memories of it as I have painful ones.

g.title: j1680351110
g.text: So it's not your garbage disposal, either.

g.title: j201539268
g.text: So I have to be there to protect it when it's in danger.

g.title: j1604865659
g.text: And just because I wanted to be free of it, doesn't mean I want it all to suffer.

g.title: j863148211
g.text: You're asking me to make other people suffer.

g.title: j4190206040
g.text: Think about what you're asking me to do, Flare.

g.title: j4281456566
g.text: Would you really want to endanger a whole other world like that?

g.text: +5 Chemistry
